title: Build Array With Stack Operations
problemStatement: Given a strictly increasing target array and an integer n, construct the target array starting from an empty array by reading numbers from 1 to n. For each number read: You may perform a "Push" operation. If the number should not remain in the array, immediately perform a "Pop". Return the sequence of operations required to build the target array.
input: Integer m Target array Integer n
output: A list of operations (Push and Pop).
